title: ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the conditions and practices that maintain food quality and prevent contamination."

Hygiene promotion is the active encouragement of hygienic behaviours through awareness campaigns, demonstrations, and supportive policies.

Environmental quality refers to the degree to which environmental conditions meet established standards that safeguard health and ecological balance.

Sustainability refers to meeting present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

Housing refers to the physical structures that provide protection, privacy, and comfort for individuals and families.

The environment refers to the totality of external conditions, influences, and forces that affect the life, development, and survival of living organisms.
